spans.s:
(उ,) घृणु 8th cl. (घर्णोति घणुते)
To shine.
(इ) घृणि r. 1st cl. (घृणते)
To take or accept.

(-णा)
1 Reproach, blame, censure, &c.
2 Compassion, tenderness, pity.
E.
घृण to shine, अङ् and टाप् affixes, or घृ to sprinkle, with णक् and टाप् affs.

m. (-णिः)
1 A ray of the sun or moon.
2 The sun.
3 Water.
E.
घृण to shine, affix इन्; or घृ to sprinkle, Uṇādi नि.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Abused, hated.
2 Pitied.
E.
घृणा pity, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि)
1 Censorious, abusive.
2 Compassionate.
E.
घृणा, and इनि aff.
